name: FindReferencesWindow
src_typeComment: Toolkit/Find References: "what actually uses this?" before you rename/delete/refactor it. Drag any asset (or a scene object, for the scene search) into the target field, then search either or both: - Search Open Scene(s): walks every GameObject in every currently loaded scene and inspects each component's serialized fields directly (via SerializedObject/SerializedProperty), so it finds real Inspector-wired references, not a fragile text/name match. - Search Project Assets: uses AssetDatabase.GetDependencies(path, recursive: false) on every prefab/ material/ScriptableObject/scene/controller/clip in the project — Unity's own dependency database, not a raw text search through .prefab/.asset YAML, so it's both fast and accurate.
